claims.claim: Ruleset Protect Main active, targets default branch (verified live via gh api; repo evidence is the gate job comment)
Rules: deletion, non_fast_forward, creation, pull_request (0 approvals), required_status_checks (verified live via gh api; repo evidence is the gate job comment)
Required checks: CLAAssistant, DCO, SonarCloud Analysis; not strict (verified live via gh api; repo evidence is the gate job comment)
No classic branch protection and no tag ruleset (live gh api 404)
One integration bypass actor, mode always (verified live via gh api; repo evidence is the gate job comment)
docs-only PRs satisfy SonarCloud Analysis through the skipped dependabot-gate job
DCO sign-off enforced by commit-msg hook scripts/commit-msg.sh
release creates tags vX.Y.Z, runtime/, pkg/, sdk/, server/a2a/ with github-actions[bot]
Changing required checks must name the job as GitHub reports it; renaming a required job blocks every pull request
The ruleset requires no approving review, signed commits or linear history
